spec.name: Medresa Ben Youssef
spec.description: The Medresa Ben Youssef is one of Marrakech's most important historic monuments and one of the finest examples of Saadian architecture. It served as an important center of Islamic learning and is known for its large central courtyard, carved stucco, cedar woodwork, marble and traditional zellige decoration.

access.comment: Opening hours and entrance fees may change. Check the official website before visiting.

timeline.title: Saadian construction
timeline.description: The current medresa was completed during the reign of the Saadian sultan Abdallah al-Ghalib.

timeline.title: End of educational use
timeline.description: The medresa ceased functioning as a religious college.

timeline.title: Opened as a historic monument
timeline.description: Following restoration work, the medresa became accessible to visitors as a historic monument.

timeline.title: Major restoration
timeline.description: The monument closed for an extensive restoration and conservation program.

timeline.title: Reopened to visitors
timeline.description: The restored Medresa Ben Youssef reopened to the public.
